answer_1.quote: ... we study the following research question: "Can TOXICSPANS data and toxic span detectors be used to assess the mitigation of explicit toxicity in toxic-to-civil transfer?" ... we examine toxic-to-civil transfer, showing how toxic spans can help shed more light on this task too, by helping assess how well systems and humans address explicit toxicity.
answer_1.outputs: Civil rephrased versions of toxic posts (style‑transfer / paraphrase generation)

answer_2.quote: ... we report accuracy (ACC), perplexity (PPL), similarity (SIM), and the geometric mean (GM) of ACC, 1/PPL, SIM. Accuracy measures the rate of successful transfers ... Perplexity is used here as a measure of fluency ... Similarity measures content preservation ...
